desc: Sprawling microbrewery & hotspot with a quirky interior, outdoor seating & multicuisine fare.
addr: No.57, 1st Main Rd, Sarakki Industrial Layout, Dollar Layout, 3rd Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t: The place is decent, food and drinks are reasonably priced (Bangalore pub standards). The brews were good, but the food was average. The crispy fried corn and the crispy chicken burger that I tried were okay, but not something I'd crave to …
Good Ambience and it's super huge place. Songs played by DJ and speaker quality was great. Just don't go to this place when it's raining you will regret. Other than that great place to hangout. …
We went for some lunch. Ordered Pizza, Chicken Tikka, Spring Roll and Cheese Balls. All the dishes were good but the Chicken BBQ Pizza was the best of all. The place is beautiful. …
